title: Head, GCFO AI Lead(Singapore, India)
description:
**Job Summary**
This role could be based in Singapore or India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.
  
  

* The GCFO AI lead is accountable for transforming the Finance operating model through process excellence, re-engineering, intelligent automation, and artificial intelligence.
* The role leads the redesign and optimization of GCFO's end-to-end processes, controls, data, and operating model, embedding simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across the function. As the architect of Finance transformation, the role drives continuous improvement, productivity, control effectiveness, and digital innovation, creating a highly efficient, insight-led, and AI-enabled Finance organisation.
* Beyond GCFO, the role serves as the senior Finance representative across Bank-wide AI and transformation initiatives, ensuring GCFO priorities are reflected in the enterprise AI agenda while accelerating the adoption of responsible AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the function. The role partners with Technology, Data, Operations, Risk, and Business leaders to identify enterprise use cases, influence investment priorities, and scale innovation that delivers measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Define and own the GCFO Process Excellence and AI Strategy, establishing a clear vision for a future-state Finance platform that is integrated, scalable, resilient, data-driven, and AI-enabled.
* Shape and deliver the long-term GCFO transformation agenda, translating strategic objectives into a coherent platform roadmap with clear outcomes, milestones, investment priorities, and measurable business value.
* Serve as the Finance and Treasury champion for enterprise-wide AI transformation, representing GCFO across Bank-wide AI initiatives, influencing cross-functional priorities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's AI strategy.
* Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations, Data, and the Businesses to identify, prioritize, and scale AI opportunities that deliver sustainable productivity, control, and commercial benefits.
* Architect future-ready operating models that support business growth, enhance organizational agility, and reduce complexity, operational risk, and cost.
* Champion intelligent automation and digital transformation through the adoption of workflow technologies, RPA, AI/ML, agentic capabilities, and next-generation productivity solutions.
* Ensure alignment with Group Finance, Risk, Technology, Data, and regulatory strategies while maintaining strong governance, controls, resilience, and audit readiness across both traditional and digital-asset environments.
* Contribute to the development of the Bank's AI standards, governance frameworks, control environment, and Responsible AI practices, ensuring safe, ethical, and compliant adoption of AI across the enterprise.
* Monitor emerging AI technologies, regulatory developments, and industry-leading practices, identifying opportunities that advance Finance and Treasury capabilities while strengthening the Bank's competitive advantage.

**Business**

* Strengthen GCFO’s business partnering model with Finance, Risk, Technology, and the wider business.
* Ensure GCFO PE and AI materially improves decision-making quality, speed, and insight through predictive, prescriptive, and generative analytics.
* Support growth, product innovation, and balance-sheet optimisation, including emerging tokenised financial products.
* Act decisively to address risk and control weaknesses, ensuring issues are remediated and escalated appropriately.

**Processes**

* Process, Control & Organisation Layer: Establish integrated controllership and operating-model capabilities including iCon, ARIS, Signavio, ProHance, M7, CIMCON, ServiceNow, and WalkMe, embedding control-by-design and auditability.
* Drive standardisation & harmonisation of processes across regions & business units
* Drive technology enablement and integration across a complex systems landscape including SAP, non-SAP ERP applications, and emerging AI solutions, ensuring seamless data flow and process automation that reduces manual effort and strengthens controls.
* Pioneer the adoption of Agent AI and intelligent automation within controllership processes, evaluating use cases, managing implementation, and realizing measurable benefits in efficiency, accuracy, and strategic value delivery.
* Intelligence Layer: Deliver AI-enabled capabilities including Knowledge Graphs, vector stores, RAG, Digital Twins, LLMs, and Agents to enable advanced analytics and decision support across finance and digital-asset domains.
* Define defect prevention programs & implement mistake-proofing techniques across critical processes

**People & Talent**

* Build and lead a high-performing GCFO Process excellence organisation spanning platform ownership, product management, data, AI, engineering, and digital-asset expertise.
* Develop future-ready GCFO talent and act as an evangelist for GCFO digital enablement, and AI adoption.

**Risk Management**

* Reinforce an exemplary risk and control culture across all GCFO platforms and processes, including those supporting digital assets and tokenised products.
* Maintain compliance with key regulatory and financial reporting standards.
* Strengthen the control environment while driving process simplification and efficiency.
* Embed audit readiness through disciplined governance, documentation, and testing.

**Governance**

* Establish control and review frameworks for GCFO platforms and processes, ensuring compliance with Group Control Governance and EUC policies.
* Define and update relevant policies, standards, and guidelines, and ensure platforms are benchmarked against industry best practice.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, regulatory compliance, and business conduct across GCFO.
* Resolve audit and regulatory issues with sustainable, long-term solutions.

**Key stakeholders**

* Group CFO and GCFO Leadership Team
* GCFO COO Management Team
* Group Finance, Risk, Technology, and Data Office
* Audit, Compliance, and Regulators
* Regional and Cluster CFOs.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* 20+ years of experience with a strong track record of transformation in Finance & Accounting including controllership , FP&A , Regulatory reporting etc
* Proven experience delivering large-scale finance transformation programmes in an international bank or equivalent regulated institution
* Strong understanding of Generative AI , LLMs , AI agents , Automation and Analytics
* Quantifiable benefits through cost reduction, productivity , faster close , better forecasting and controls
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Finance AI use cases – Experience applying AI to forecasting, reporting , treasury ,controllership and reconciliations
* AI Governance – Strong understanding of responsible AI, model risk , controls and regulatory requirements
* Technology ecosystem – Expert in ERP platforms such as SAP , cloud platforms , GenAI platforms and enterprise AI tools
* Deep, hands-on expertise in digital assets, process mapping, analysis, and redesign using tools like ARIS, Signavio, or Celonis
* Strong understanding of accounting, valuation, liquidity, capital, and risk implications of crypto assets, tokenised deposits, stablecoins, CBDCs, and other digital instruments.
* Experience integrating on-chain and off-chain data and distributed-ledger technologies into enterprise finance and risk platforms.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt certification preferred
* Professional certifications (CA, CPA, CFA, CIMA, or equivalent) highly valued

**Role Specific Technical Competencies**

* Proven experience in delivering large scale global solution deployments preferably in the financial services environment
* Finance Domain expertise
* Process reengineering
* AI Strategy Roadmap
* AI Tools and Assets
* Identification & Management of project Risk/Assumptions/Issues/ Dependencies
* Advanced Components, e.g. Knowledge Graphs, Agents, LLMs
* Data and Analytics
* Change and Adoption
* Banking and Regulatory knowledge

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

**Recruitment Assessments**
Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.
  
  
Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

title: Associate, Specialist, Data Engineer-Database Admin, Technology and Operations
description:
**Business Function**
 Technology and Operations (T\&O) enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality \& control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group T\&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.
   

  

**Job Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Administer and maintain databases including MS SQL DB, MariaDB, Oracle DB and PostgreSQL for various business application
* Primary expertise should be MS SQL \& Maria Database.
* Monitor database performance, capacity, backups and security.
* Expert in Backup \& Recovery.
* Perform database patching, upgrades and ensure compliance with internal guidelines and external regulations
* Participate in application development projects and be responsible for the database architecture and design.
* Handle database related incidents, problems and complaints in a timely manner
* Responsible for developer SQL code review to ensure queries are optimized and tuned to perform efficiently prior to production release.
* Coordinate with internal teams on database requirements, changes, deployments and performance tuning.
* Understanding of basic database fundamentals: multi\-version control, concurrency, transactions, indexing, locking.
* Analyze, recommend, and implement configuration for Optimized Performance.
* Ability to plan hardware capacity requirements for storage, memory, and CPU Cycles.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to peers on best practices for database administration and management
* Understanding of UNIX environment with shell scripting.
* Familiarity with Linux administration
* Contribute to document company database standards, guidelines, and operational procedures
* Perform a variety of tasks relying on experience and judgment to manage time, plan and accomplish goals on several client engagements
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills


**Required Experience**
* At least 6 years of experience administering SQL Server databases \& Maria database.
* Excellent communication, customer service, organizational, project and personnel management skills.
* Knowledge of database security best practices and compliance requirements.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaborate effectively within a team
* Independent thinking and ability to demonstrate good judgment required
* Cloud computing experience would be an advantage


**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
* A degree in Computer Science or related subject is preferred


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong knowledge in MS SQL and Maria database, backup/recovery of database, Disaster recovery plan.


**Personal Skills**
* Strong matrix management skills including influence, conflict resolution and negotiation
* Excellent relationship building and networking skills


**Additional Skills**
* Team leadership, collaboration, decisiveness, energy and drive


**Location:**
 I\-Think Techno, Kanjurmarg
   

  

**Job:**
 Technology
   

  

**Schedule:**
 Regular
   

  

**Employee Status:**
 Full time
